derivation: Derived from constructed disjoint pairs, without invoking the engine: quantities 1..250 each have one BUY and one SELL at the same minute/stock reference; BUY limits exceed SELL limits and both are inside the 10% band. Each seller starts with 2000 shares per stock and sells at most 1375. Each rejected row is invalid before reservation. Each pair executes at its SELL limit, transfers its quantity once, and contributes quantity times SELL limit to trade value. Final valuation uses minute-49 quotes.
